purpose: Create final operator documentation and a sanitized read-only execution baseline without changing code or entering the maintenance cutover.
allowed_operations: read-only Git, process, count, hash, token-presence, status, and secret-pattern audit
create sanitized operator documentation and final baseline evidence
prohibited_actions: modify business code, Gateway architecture, Analyzer, Router, OpenClaw core, Binding, Agent, Cron, OAuth, model, production configuration, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
read, request, print, hash, persist, or pass a token value
stop Core Feishu, start or restart a production Project Gateway, send real Feishu traffic, commit, push, or tag
hard_gates: unknown Core consumer state remains unknown
a documentation checklist never authorizes a production action
no command reference may imply a currently disabled control is executed or qualified
secrets: Only booleans, hashes, counts, statuses, and redacted findings may be persisted.
